inherited.M01: GRID, LRW and LRS3 overt-speech video corpora with paired audio; no new collection
inherited.M02: Real-audio 80-band log-mel targets, no text labels (paired-audio supervision, the field default)
inherited.M04: Overt speech video with audio muted at test
inherited.M05: Single camera, 96x96 grayscale mouth crop from 68 landmarks, 20 fps
inherited.M08: Waveform audio from predicted mel spectrograms (folded into M06)
inherited.M13: Vocoder throughput on one RTX 2080 Ti; no device, cost or safety constraint

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video and report the acoustic representation and how it becomes a waveform; enhancement with noisy audio at test, talking-head generation, text-only lip reading and video-to-text-to-TTS excluded; versions once.
topics.metric: LRS3 ASR WER on the SVTS unseen-speaker split; GRID and LRW WER

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: the same 165-study population, classified by whether the waveform generator is trained with the visual path or is a pre-trained or separately trained vocoder; a study counts under every design its full text names (upper bound).
topics.design_field: published full-text regexes pretrained_vocoder, joint_waveform_training, ddsp_or_harmonic_noise

topics.inclusion_rule: The 165-study video-to-speech population of components/M06/video-to-speech-synthesis, classified from the full text (reference list removed) by the training corpora and scale it names: GRID, LRW, LRS3, VoxCeleb2 audio-visual data, a corpus size of 1,000 hours or more, and model-size scaling. Boundary: a study counts under every corpus its text names, including related-work and evaluation-only mentions (upper bound); audio-only pre-training corpora are not counted; versions once.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes grid_data, lrw_data, lrs3_data, voxceleb2_audiovisual_data, over_1000_hours, model_size_scaling
topics.metric: presence of the design; LRS3 unseen-speaker metrics for the effect of added data

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: the same 165-study population, classified by the speaker information supplied at use time (embedding from reference audio, from the face or lip video, or none); training-only or scoring-only embeddings do not count (upper bound).
topics.metric: SECS and WER with audio- versus video-derived embeddings

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: the video-to-speech population classified by how the ASR-WER text reference is built (ASR transcript of the real audio) and whether the ASR error on the real test audio is reported (upper bound).
topics.metric: ASR WER on the real test audio

topics.inclusion_rule: Reused published table: the same video-to-speech population, counting the evaluation protocols its full text names (listener test, ASR WER on output, unseen speakers) (upper bound).
topics.metric: listener test; LRS3 WER under one ASR
